page.layout: One printed page: running head and page number at top; one text column, with three marginal notes in the left margin beside its first lines. The right edge is the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: tatem Justitiæ apud Deum. Tale igitur Meritum de Condigno esse oportet, quale Adversarii discipulis suis credendum propinârunt. Minoris igitur nobis incumbit probatio.

Contrariam Pontificiorum sententiam à vera Theologia prorsus abhorrere, ex Pon-tificiis Theologis ostendent ii, qui vel Consequentiis suis labefactârunt, vel etiam ingenuis suis Confessionibus eam rejiciendam esse duxerunt. Vasquez denuo intromittendus est, ut intelligamus, an is, qui antea Protestantes perstrinxit, sustinere velit suos Pontificios Doctores in castris nostris militare: Vasquez in 1.1.Tom. 2. disp.214. Cap.5.n.23. §Primo.{p} Si ratio meriti nostrorum operum, inquit, provenit ex promissione & acceptatione Dei, efficitur ut justitia, quâ redditur æterna vita bene laborantibus, non attendatur in compensatione: Item, Idem ibid. num.19.§. Circa hanc.{q} Hæ-retici, inquit, ipsi (sic enim, quæ est ejus erga nos benevolentia, Protestantes appellat) æqualitatem hanc in complenda promissione non inficiantur. Denique expresse dicit, Opinionem hanc prorsus tollere rationem Meriti. Hactenus Vasquez: In quem insurgent veteris Scholæ magni nominis Doctores, Scotus, Gregorius, Gabriel, Ockam; qui (fatente eodem Jesuitâ) tradiderunt, Vasquez quo supra, c.1.num.2. §Prima.{r} Opera justorum in se spectata, quatenus procedunt ex auxilio Gratiæ Dei, & posità sanctitate animâ, per quam S. San-ctus in justis habitat, non habere condignitatem [?]

page.notes: The scan is dark and blurred at the foot of the column; the last line is cut off by the lower edge of the text and reads only partly. "Pon-tificiis" and "Ha-retici" are doubtful at the line ends. The marginal note "in 1.1.Tom." is uncertain and may read "1.2.Tom.". "Æqualitatem" is doubtful as to capital or lower case. "S. Sanctus" is partly obscured and is given as "San-ctus" with a doubtful reading. The mark at the lower right of the column and the small mark beneath the text are not clearly legible and are not transcribed. The text in the right margin is the neighbouring page and is not included.
